sources.snippet: Overview z-image-turbo is a 6-billion-parameter text-to-image diffusion model developed by Tongyi-MAI and optimized by prunaai for inference speed. It generates images from text prompts at resolutions up to 2048×2048 pixels, with default generation at 1024×1024.
